newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan stocks extend decline in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Jordan stocks extend decline in slow trade.

text.p: Jordanian stocks fell for a fifth consecutive trading day on Saturday, edging down 0.1 percent in the slowest trade for nearly a month.
The Amman Financial Market 60-share index fell 0.15 points to 147.97 points in turnover worth a meagre 256,000 dinars ($362,000).
"It's a weak market, both in price and volume," said one broker, citing a continued shortage of cash on the market.
Brokers said a Central Bank decision last week to release hundreds of millions of dollars of commercial bank deposits from compulsory reserves had failed to spark the bourse.
"There are better places for the banks to put their money than on the exchange -- most of the quoted companies are losing money," said one.

Arab Potash was the busiest share on Saturday, closing unchanged at 5.60 dinars after shares worth 43,000 dinars were traded. The little-traded General Investment was the market's biggest climber, rising 4.84 percent to 3.03 dinars in a one-off deal worth 1,210 dinars.
The Amman bourse slipped below 136 points in July before rebounding above 152 points in September, buoyed by government pledges of commitment to economic reform.

But in October it moved less than a point either side of 147.50 points. Brokers said stalled self-rule talks between Israel and Palestinians and growing doubts that neighbouring Iraq would export oil in 1996 had added to domestic worries over high interest rates and paralysed the bourse.
Limited trading in a handful of shares has kept the market ticking over.

"Investors are encouraged to buy selective blue chip stocks at current prices as many of them are selling at P/Es (price-earnings ratios) far below the market (average) of 14.1," market analysts Pearl Consulting said in their review of October trading.
But brokers saw little cheer for the rest of the week's trading. "It's more likely to get worse than better," said one.
Overall 11 shares rose, 13 fell and another 13 traded but closed unchanged.
